form.label: QNAP NAS Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage view for QNAP NAS QuLog event and connection syslog records. Dashboard presence does not imply replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=qnap:nas:conn host=$host_filter$ action="login_fail" | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype=qnap:nas:* host=$host_filter$ | timechart count by sourcetype
index=$index$ sourcetype=qnap:nas:* host=$host_filter$ | eval qnap_signal=coalesce(action,qnap_category,signature) | top limit=12 qnap_signal

index=$index$ sourcetype=qnap:nas:* host=$host_filter$ | stats count values(action) as actions values(qnap_connection_type) as connection_types values(qnap_application) as applications by user src | sort - count | head 20
index=$index$ sourcetype=qnap:nas:conn host=$host_filter$ | table _time host user src qnap_computer_name qnap_connection_type qnap_resource action signature _raw | sort - _time | head 50
index=$index$ sourcetype=qnap:nas:event host=$host_filter$ | table _time host user src qnap_computer_name qnap_application qnap_category action signature message _raw | sort - _time | head 50

index=$index$ sourcetype=qnap:nas:* host=$host_filter$ | stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen dc(marker) as fixture_markers by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

index=$index$ sourcetype=qnap:nas:* host=$host_filter$ | table _time index sourcetype source host vendor product user src action signature qnap_application qnap_category qnap_connection_type qnap_resource marker _raw | sort - _time | head 100

html.p: Scope and evidence boundary: This dashboard is limited to fixture-backed QNAP qulogd event log and conn log syslog rows. It does not prove full QuLog catalogue coverage, official QNAP source-version validation, collector health, or SC4S/Splunk replay/read-back validation.
